tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF files (in order) into one PDF. Returns base64 of the merged PDF.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Extract selected pages from a PDF. Returns base64 of the extracted PDF.

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Rotate some or all pages of a PDF by 90/180/270 degrees. Returns base64 of the rotated PDF.

tools.name: pdf_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF, per page. Pass as_markdown=true for a clean Markdown version with '## Page N' headings.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: PDF metadata: page count, byte size, document info fields.

tools.name: pdf_safe_scan
tools.description: Scan a PDF for hostile content: JavaScript, embedded files, Launch/Open actions, XFA forms, encryption. Returns verdict (likely_safe/suspicious/dangerous), risk_score and findings. Static heuristics, NOT an antivirus.

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Generate a QR code PNG for a text or URL. Returns base64 PNG (image/png).
